events.name: Zach Mama (aka “Monica”) Headlines The Riot Comedy Club
events.description: 75 million views, 140k+ followers — Zach Mama is comedy’s next big thingWith an online reach exceeding 75 million views and 140,000 followers, Zach Mama is a French-American comedian, jazz drummer, and writer currently touring the United States while filming a self-funded documentary about stand-up comedy. After moving to the U.S. to study jazz, Mama transitioned to comedy, developing a laid-back, sharp observational style rooted in his outsider perspective and improvisational background. His material blends cultural commentary, personal storytelling, and crowd work shaped by years on stage across both Europe and America.Mama has performed in clubs and theaters nationwide and has opened for legendary comedian Tony Woods, a longtime mentor to Dave Chappelle. His growing online presence has brought him a global audience, with viral clips and stand-up segments reaching millions of viewers across platforms. His recent work surrounding his “Monica” bit sparked widespread online discussion and coverage, further expanding his reach beyond traditional comedy circuits.Currently, Mama is couchsurfing across all 50 states, documenting the lives of comedians and the realities of touring stand-up in America. The project combines travel, interviews, and live performances into a raw, personal portrait of comedy as both survival and artistic pursuit. Along the way, he has performed in cities across the country, building a grassroots following through word of mouth and social media.In addition to stand-up, Mama continues to perform as a jazz drummer and incorporates musical sensibility into his comedic timing and rhythm. He is actively touring, releasing new material online, and developing his documentary, positioning himself as a distinctive voice bridging European introspection with American stand-up tradition.All shows Ages 21 & Up. events.name: Comedian Courtney Gilmour (Don’t Tell Comedy) Headlines The Riot Houston
events.description: Courtney Gilmour is an award-winning comedian and television writer. In 2017 she delivered a breakout performance at the Just For Laughs Festival in Montreal by becoming the first female to win the prestigious Homegrown Comics Competition as Canada’s top comedian. Her stand-up has been featured on Don’t Tell Comedy and multiple national broadcasts from festivals including the Winnipeg Comedy Festival, Halifax Comedy Festival, JFL Vancouver as well as Kevin Hart’s LOL Network and the Howie Mandel All Stars Gala at Just For Laughs Montreal. In 2022 she was a Finalist in the second season of Canada’s Got Talent. Courtney made her U.S. Network debut on Comic’s Unleashed and as an actor, appears in season 13 of Trailer Park Boys and is the voice of Lizzy on Nickelodeon’s Paw Patrol. She’s written for and made appearances on This Hour Has 22 Minutes, CBC’s The Debaters, Space Dragon & Kim and CBC’s Humor Resources alongside Jon Dore and Sarah Silverman as well as multiple appearances on Roast Battle Canada.
